facts.claim: The High School was established in Bangalore in the year 1847.
facts.quote: The principal institution is the High School (established in 1847 in Bangalore) and its branches, educating up to the standard of matriculation at the Madras University.

facts.claim: The Wesleyan Mission started its work in the Mysore country in 1822.
facts.quote: The W'cskyan Mission commenced its work in the Mysore country in 1822, but for many years the missionaries laboured only among the Tamil people of the Cantonment of Bangalore.

facts.claim: The Canarese Mission was started in Bangalore in 1835.
facts.quote: The Canarese Mission was begun in Bangalore in 1835. The following year a lengthened tour through Mysore and Coorg was undertaken by two of the missionaries
